text: मुझे प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि के लिए पात्रता जाननी है
romanized: Mujhe Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi ke liye patrata jaanni hai
reference_translation: I want to know the eligibility for the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi.

text: क्या मैं Ayushman Bharat card के लिए eligible हूं
romanized: Kya main Ayushman Bharat card ke liye eligible hun
reference_translation: Am I eligible for the Ayushman Bharat card?

text: मेरी सालाना आय एक लाख बीस हजार रुपये है क्या मुझे आवास योजना मिलेगी
romanized: Meri salana aay ek lakh bees hazaar rupaye hai kya mujhe Awas Yojana milegi
reference_translation: My annual income is one hundred twenty thousand rupees, will I get the housing scheme?

text: मेरे पास दो एकड़ जमीन है क्या मैं किसान योजना ले सकता हूं
romanized: Mere paas do ekad zameen hai kya main Kisan Yojana le sakta hun
reference_translation: I have two acres of land, can I take the farmer scheme?

text: मेरे आवेदन की स्थिति क्या है
romanized: Mere aavedan ki sthiti kya hai
reference_translation: What is the status of my application?

text: मेरा application number दो चार सात नौ एक तीन है status बता दीजिए
romanized: Mera application number do chaar saat nau ek teen hai status bata dijiye
reference_translation: My application number is two four seven nine one three, please tell me the status.

text: मैंने पंद्रह मार्च को आवेदन किया था अभी तक पैसा नहीं आया
romanized: Maine pandrah March ko aavedan kiya tha abhi tak paisa nahi aaya
reference_translation: I applied on the fifteenth of March and the money has not arrived yet.

text: पिछली किस्त कब आई थी मुझे याद नहीं
romanized: Pichhli kist kab aayi thi mujhe yaad nahi
reference_translation: When did the last instalment arrive, I do not remember.

text: मुझे उज्ज्वला योजना के लिए आवेदन कैसे करना है
romanized: Mujhe Ujjwala Yojana ke liye aavedan kaise karna hai
reference_translation: How do I apply for the Ujjwala scheme?

text: PM Awas Yojana का form online कैसे भरें
romanized: PM Awas Yojana ka form online kaise bharen
reference_translation: How do I fill the PM Awas Yojana form online?

text: क्या मैं गांव के कॉमन सर्विस सेंटर से आवेदन कर सकता हूं
romanized: Kya main gaon ke common service center se aavedan kar sakta hun
reference_translation: Can I apply from the village common service centre?

text: आवेदन करने की आखिरी तारीख क्या है
romanized: Aavedan karne ki aakhiri tareekh kya hai
reference_translation: What is the last date to apply?

text: आवेदन के लिए कौन कौन से कागज चाहिए
romanized: Aavedan ke liye kaun kaun se kagaz chahiye
reference_translation: Which documents are needed for the application?

text: क्या Aadhaar card और bank passbook काफी है
romanized: Kya Aadhaar card aur bank passbook kaafi hai
reference_translation: Are the Aadhaar card and bank passbook enough?

text: मेरे पास राशन कार्ड नहीं है क्या वोटर आईडी चलेगा
romanized: Mere paas ration card nahi hai kya voter ID chalega
reference_translation: I do not have a ration card, will a voter ID work?

text: जमीन के कागजात कहां से लाने होंगे
romanized: Zameen ke kagzaat kahan se laane honge
reference_translation: Where do I have to get the land documents from?

text: मेरा पैसा नहीं आया मुझे शिकायत दर्ज करानी है
romanized: Mera paisa nahi aaya mujhe shikayat darj karani hai
reference_translation: My money has not arrived, I need to register a complaint.

text: मेरी complaint का अभी तक कोई reply नहीं आया
romanized: Meri complaint ka abhi tak koi reply nahi aaya
reference_translation: I have not received any reply to my complaint yet.

text: तीन महीने से मेरी किस्त रुकी हुई है
romanized: Teen mahine se meri kist ruki hui hai
reference_translation: My instalment has been stopped for three months.

text: अधिकारी मेरी बात नहीं सुन रहे हैं
romanized: Adhikari meri baat nahi sun rahe hain
reference_translation: The officers are not listening to me.
